intent: Inline status banner that stays on the page.
useWhen: Page or form feedback the user should still see after it appears
Success, warning, or danger copy tied to the current view
doNotUseWhen: Transient confirmations that disappear — not a toast; ask before adding one
A dismissible insight tile — use InsightCard

requirements: Title and body are readable text

doNot: Do not invent local Alert, Banner, or Callout
Do not use Alert for toast-style popups
